    'connections': 4096, 'packets': 32768, 'files': 8192}, 'events': []}


def pack(jobs, sep=(',', ':')):
    return json.dumps({'jobs': jobs}, separators=sep).encode()

    job = dict(GOODJOB)

            job.pop(k, None)
        else:

    return job
